layout.hierarchy: Visually dominant: the two large colored diagram panels (yellow decoder, orange encoder) occupy most of the canvas. Next: the red/blue two-line title. Then the blue bottleneck text box and the red panel labels ('Decoder (RNN)', 'Encoder  (RNN)', 'Context Vector...'). visual_elements.description: DECODER (RNN) panel: yellow rounded rectangle containing three repeated vertical columns. Column i (i=1,2,3), left to right: at top an italic output label o₁ / o₂ / o₃; below it a vertical gray arrow pointing up to the output; the word 'softmax' in italic placed to the left of each arrow; below that a light-green cell block (horizontal row of 3-4 small square cells); below that another vertical arrow; at the bottom row an orange/tan cell block (row of 3-4 small cells). Between consecutive orange blocks: rightward arrows labeled s₁ (between block 1 and 2) and s₂ (between block 2 and 3), with s₃ after block 3. Two dark curved arrows (dark green/black) sweep from below the row — one from the s₁ region curving down-right up into the bottom of the 2nd orange block, one from the s₂ region curving into the 3rd orange block — representing recurrent connections. A solid red dot sits at the left edge of the 1st orange block (decoder input = context vector).

ENCODER (RNN) panel: orange/peach rounded rectangle. Top row: three pink cell blocks (rows of 3-4 small cells); a horizontal gray arrow enters the 1st block from the left edge; between block 1→2 a rightward arrow labeled h₁ (label above arrow), between block 2→3 a rightward arrow labeled h₂; a solid red dot at the right edge of the 3rd pink block (final hidden state / context vector output). Middle row: three tan/beige cell blocks, each connected upward by a vertical gray arrow to the pink block above; italic labels 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃' placed to the left of each upward arrow. Bottom: italic labels x₁, x₂, x₃ each with a vertical gray arrow pointing up into the corresponding tan block.

Red curved connector arrow: starts at the red dot on the right edge of the encoder's 3rd pink block, curves upward (concave-left) and ends with an arrowhead at the red dot on the left edge of the decoder's 1st orange block. This is the 'context vector' passing from encoder to decoder. Thin leader lines also link this arrow/dot region to the blue bottleneck box (from its right edge) and down to the 'Context Vector (of Whole Inputs)' callout box.
